result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make empathy as fundamental and automatic as breathing.

So many of the world’s hardest problems—war, inequality, cruelty, indifference—grow from an inability or refusal to see the full humanity in others. If everyone could genuinely feel the weight of their choices on other people, we might still disagree, but we’d be far less likely to harm. That one shift would ripple into better institutions, kinder communities, and a more just world.
